strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Build a personal cross-platform VPN whose logical weak-network behavior approaches UDP/QUIC while public carriers remain stock REALITY/Vision over real kernel TCP.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: M7 bounded flight and rescue-lane experiment
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Do not add FEC/RBC, Xray/REALITY integration or TUN until sender memory/kernel enqueue is bounded and a low-occupancy rescue lane can deliver control/reinjected STREAM data without sitting behind bulk traffic.

continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: Completed M4-M6 progression. M4 joined independent real TCP carriers into one logical pool. M5 added normalized logical ACK/GAP receipts, cross-lane control return, STREAM FIN acknowledgement and a safe DATAGRAM ID bound. M6 added an immutable sender STREAM scoreboard and GAP-driven cross-lane reinjection with fresh TransmissionID, ACK pruning and stale-control tolerance. A real two-TCP localhost test proves the logical STREAM completes through lane 2 while the original prefix remains unavailable on lane 1, then the late original copy is deduplicated. Local vet, normal/race tests, protocol fuzz, handoff verification and continuity tests passed; M5 remote CI passed and M6 is the substantive checkpoint to refresh live CI against.
continuation_cursor.current_task: M7-001: bound per-lane logical flight before kernel enqueue and prototype a 2-bulk/1-rescue lane policy; still no FEC/RBC, Xray/REALITY or TUN.
continuation_cursor.why_now: Cross-lane reinjection is logically correct, but it only reduces tail latency if rescue/control data is not trapped behind already-queued bulk bytes. The next risk is queue occupancy and unbounded outstanding memory, not wire correctness.
continuation_cursor.done_when: Deterministic and real-local tests enforce configurable per-lane flight limits, prevent new bulk scheduling when a lane has exhausted credit, keep a designated rescue lane low-occupancy, allow ACK/GAP and reinjected STREAM bytes to use rescue capacity, and prove a rescued logical gap completes before gated bulk carriers are released. Lane failure/close must preserve accounting without leaks.
continuation_cursor.next_atomic_action: M7-001: add per-lane logical flight/credit accounting above lane.Pool and a 2-bulk/1-rescue scheduler policy. Build deterministic plus three-real-TCP localhost tests where bulk lanes are intentionally gated/occupied while the rescue lane stays available; prove control and M6 reinjection complete the logical STREAM before bulk release. Do not add FEC/RBC, Xray/REALITY or TUN yet.
